title: GDPR erasure backlog - wave B of 3
description:
Clear the supplemental GDPR Right-to-Erasure backlog that accumulated after the Q3 batch, processed in three waves to keep each maintenance window short. This is wave B: 7 users submitted verified deletion requests and the 30-day cooling period has elapsed for all of them. Apply migration 014_gdpr_backlog_wave_b.sql to user-service.

Scope:
- Delete personal data for the 7 users listed in migrations/gdpr_backlog_wave_b.csv
- Scope limited to the users table
- Generate a deletion confirmation report for Legal/Compliance

Per the GDPR deletion runbook, screen the batch against the legal-hold registry (compliance/legal_holds.json). Remember: only an ACTIVE hold blocks deletion; RELEASED or EXPIRED holds do not.
